metadata.description: Agent skills for personal projects: pull request review verification, a single cloud entry for AWS, Google Cloud, and Cloudflare, multi-page architecture sites for existing codebases, and content structure for documents, decision records, and pages.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Verifies pull request review findings from automated reviewers or humans before changing any code. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: cloud
plugins.description: One entry for AWS, Google Cloud, and Cloudflare: learn a service, evaluate and price options, design an architecture, and set up resources with Terraform.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Turns an existing codebase into a multi-page, diagram-led architecture site with linked diagrams and panels, conclusions only, and code line refs pinned to a commit. Uses the content rules in the docs plugin.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Sets the content structure before writing a document, decision record (ADR), or page: reader and task, one doc type, skeleton, acceptance questions, and a reviewer check before publishing. Ships a single-page skeleton with build and check scripts.
